auditor_firm_name: Price Waterhouse LLP, Chartered Accountants and Batliboi & Purohit, Chartered Accountants (Joint Statutory Auditors)
emphasis_of_matter: Other Matters paragraph: The special purpose financial information of erstwhile HDFC Limited as at the appointed and effective date of amalgamation (1 July 2023) was audited by other auditors, whose unmodified opinion has been furnished to the Joint Statutory Auditors; the auditors' opinion is not modified in respect of this matter. Additionally, under Report on Other Legal and Regulatory Requirements, the auditors noted that transactions of the Bank which came to their notice were within the powers of the Bank, other than those relating to leasing of immovable properties acquired on amalgamation of erstwhile HDFC Limited (disclosed in Schedule 18, Note 1 of the Standalone Financial Statements); the opinion is not modified in respect of this matter.
key_concerns_flagged_by_auditor: (1) Leasing of immovable properties acquired through the amalgamation of erstwhile HDFC Limited — noted as transactions outside the normal powers of the Bank (disclosed in Schedule 18, Note 1). (2) Allowance for Credit Losses (ACL) — identified as a Key Audit Matter due to significant judgement in estimating collective ACL, including Probability of Default (PD), Loss Given Default (LGD) models, macroeconomic assumptions, and credit rating models for wholesale and retail loan pools.
